title: Dye
description: Three blots spread, overlap and show the cloth beneath.
alt: Soft blue, rose and yellow blots grow from three points, overlap into darker mixed tones, reveal a fine checked texture, then fade.
note: Describing each blot as a circle disturbed by three sine waves gives soft, uneven edges without any filter. Reusing the same shapes as the mask keeps the cloth texture exactly inside the dye.
author: Maria Roszyk
